resources.string: A tap on SYM makes the next key type its symbol, without opening the symbols. Tap SYM twice to open them. Holding SYM works either way.
Tap the emoji key for one emoji
A tap on the emoji key makes the next key type its emoji from the emoji layer. Tap it twice to open the emoji screen. Holding the emoji key and pressing a key types that key\'s emoji either way.
A fifth status LED for the emoji key, lit while it\'s held and locked while it\'s tapped or an emoji screen is open. The other LEDs shrink to make room.
